dedupe_keys.name: jrc flood hazard map series of 6 event data sets

description: JRC Flood Hazard Map (series of 6 event data sets) is a series of data sets listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by ICPAC. JRC Flood Hazard Map for 50 years return period for the GHoA Region (excluding Djibuti). The map has a resolution of 30 arc seconds (~1 km at the equator), it is taken from the dataset by Dottori et al. (2016) assuming no flood protections. Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal lists 6 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher ICPAC. The portal shows 2021-05-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
